description: This file defines a test scenario class 'Scenario4MultipleSubjects16' that sets up a specific permissions-related test case for the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements the Scenario4MultipleSubjects interface and provides a method to return setup details and a function to evaluate permissions via a PolicyAlgorithm.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects16
classes.description: A test scenario class for multiple subjects with specific permissions setup and an algorithm application function.

methods.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects16
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scenario setup with specific permissions and context.

methods.name: getSetup
methods.description: Returns the scenario setup object containing permission configurations.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns a function that applies a PolicyAlgorithm to check permissions on resources or their subresources.
